blocks.text: This product is re-newed and comes with warranty. Google instant tethering: get online easier when you're away from wi-fi. With a quick one-step pairing your chromebook can be unlocked by your mobile device when nearby or send and receive messages through the web. Google assistant: work faster and smarter with Google assistant. Seamlessly multitask, ask questions and control your cromebook entertainment all hands free with a simple voice command. Google play store: millions of android apps you know and love on your phone and tablet can now run on your chrome device without compromising their speed, simplicity, or security
